briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Michigan Crowns Its Best Flower While D.C. Inches Toward Rescheduling
briefs.top: Michigan's cannabis scene had plenty to celebrate this week — awards, a new Ypsilanti storefront, and a gubernatorial candidate courting the industry's vote on tax relief — even as regulators keep tightening the screws on bad actors. Nationally, Wall Street is getting more bullish on rescheduling odds and MSOs are consolidating fast, even with the DEA's own timeline hitting a procedural speed bump.

local.text: Mitten Canna, Hytek sweep 2026 Zalympix awards
local.detail: Mitten Canna Co.'s Toad Venom won best overall flower and Hytek's Oishii Piña took best live rosin at the state's 'Grammys of Cannabis.'

local.text: Bloom City Club opens new Ypsilanti storefront
local.detail: The Ann Arbor-rooted retailer is celebrating its new Ypsilanti location with a full month of cannabis-themed events.

local.text: John James pledges to repeal 24% wholesale tax
local.detail: Michigan's top cannabis executives have endorsed the GOP governor candidate over his promise to cut the state's 24% wholesale weed tax.

local.text: Bargain Michigan weed pulls shoppers across state lines
local.detail: With ounces running about $60 versus $150–$220 in Ohio and Illinois, small border-town dispensaries are now outselling Detroit shops.

local.text: Regulators drop record $2M fine, pull 20 licenses
local.detail: The CRA revoked a Clare grower's licenses after it shipped packages of dirt and mulch instead of flower, the second matching $2M penalty in two weeks as the agency cleans up the market.

national.text: DEA pauses rescheduling hearing, sets Oct. 13 deadline
national.detail: The DEA's chief administrative law judge stayed the marijuana rescheduling proceeding to weigh a new GAO report, ordering the government to respond by October 13.

national.text: Investors grow more bullish on rescheduling odds
national.detail: A new survey found marijuana investors assign 65% odds to federal rescheduling within six months, with nearly half more bullish on MSOs than six months ago.

national.text: Curaleaf's $270M hostile bid targets Aurora Cannabis
national.detail: The MSO launched an unsolicited cross-border takeover offer for the Canadian producer at roughly US$270 million as consolidation accelerates.

national.text: Vireo Growth scales fast via Eaze, Glass House deals
national.detail: Vireo completed its Eaze merger for California delivery infrastructure and struck a dispensary joint venture with Glass House Brands, adding multi-channel reach.

national.text: Compass Pathways partners with VA on psilocybin trial
national.detail: The biotech is donating its COMP360 psilocybin treatment for a VA-backed study targeting treatment-resistant depression and PTSD in veterans.
